name: @pipeworx/mcp-openreview

tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List venue groups (conferences, workshops). Use the returned group id to query submissions.

query.description: Free-text filter on group id / name

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: Papers submitted to an academic CONFERENCE venue on OpenReview — ICLR, NeurIPS, ICML, COLM and similar. PREFER for "ICLR 2024 papers about diffusion models", "NeurIPS submissions on RLHF", "what did ICML publish on optimizers". Pass the venue group id as venue_id (use list_venues to find it) together with a topic in query.

query.description: Topic to search for within the venue, e.g. "diffusion models". Required in practice — OpenReview no longer serves an unfiltered listing to automated clients.

sort.description: cdate (creation date, default desc) | tmdate (modify date) | number

tools.name: get_note
tools.description: Single note — paper, review, comment, decision, etc.

details.description: Comma-sep extras: replies, original, revisions, edges

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Paper + all child notes (reviews, rebuttal, decision, metareview). Pass the forum id (= paper note id).

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Full-text search across OpenReview notes (papers, reviews, decisions) by query string; optionally restrict to a content field (e.g. title, abstract) or filter by author signature; returns matching note ids, titles, and venues.

signature.description: Filter by signature group (e.g. author profile id)

venue_id.description: Restrict to one venue group id, e.g. "ICLR.cc/2024/Conference" (use list_venues to find it).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openreview forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openreview pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
